summary: Frontend-only test of the hackathon polish. Everything requested works: 4 KPI tiles render and readings-today goes up live (3,767 -> 3,780 in 25s); the Esri dark map loads 20/20 tiles with 3 site markers coloured by worst status (amber = Main Processing Plant, green x2); hovering a marker shows the tooltip with site name, location, meter count and status; clicking a marker opens /nodes/<id>; all 6 spark-SIM-HV-00x sparklines render as SVG and update live; meters show Normal (5) and Warning (Cooling Tower Feed), none Offline, 6/6 reporting; no 'Demo' or Rand/R/ZAR amounts on Overview, Incidents, Sites, Settings (all 4 tabs), Platform, Test scenarios or meter detail; at 390px nothing overflows horizontally (scrollWidth 390) and KPIs, map and cards stack; operator and viewer logins reach the overview and the viewer has no Platform nav. No page errors. Found 3 small design issues.

issues: The .amz-tip dark style is overridden by leaflet.css (same specificity, leaflet.css loads later). The computed background is rgb(255,255,255), so the tooltip shows as a default white box on the dark map. Fix: use the selector '.leaflet-tooltip.amz-tip' (and '.leaflet-tooltip-top.amz-tip::before') in App.css.
document.title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App'. Set it to 'AmanziAlert' in public/index.html for the judges.
Each chart card has about 70-80px of empty space under the chart. Make the chart taller or the card shorter.

action_items: Raise the specificity of .amz-tip so the dark map tooltip style applies
Change the page title from 'Emergent | Fullstack App' to AmanziAlert
Optional: remove the empty space under the charts on the meter detail page
critical_code_review_comments: OrgDataContext refresh(): the initial trends from the last 8 min are not sliced to TREND_MAX (48), while the live appends are. The sparkline length changes after the first live point. Minor.
readingsToday uses count:'estimated'. On large tables the Postgres estimate can be stale or rounded, so the tile may jump on refresh. Use 'exact' if accuracy matters.
The SiteMap marker click goes to the site's first meter only. This is fine but could be a site view.
The _maintenance OFFLINE->status recovery runs every 60s, so a meter that reconnects can show Offline for up to about 60s.
seed_data_creation: None. No data was created and the MEDIUM incident on Cooling Tower Feed was left alone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Overview nav testid is nav-dashboard. Meter cards are node-card-<EUI>, status is node-status-<EUI>, sparklines are spark-<EUI> (svg with a polyline). Map markers are '[data-testid=site-map] path.leaflet-interactive'. KPI values are <kpi-testid>-value.
